protocol.comparison_note: Separate-pool flag-off controls; unified flag off plus HiCache fails startup. Workloads and explicit capacities match the earlier unified matrix.

flag_off_hicache_followup.head: 6f168a98d8438f3cb8bfd7ecfbfd9c2efa15b5e2
flag_off_hicache_followup.scope: Both DFlash cache flags off; paired HiCache on/off controls with unified memory disabled. This differs in allocator layout from the original matrix.

unified_startup_probe.failure_message: ValueError: --enable-unified-memory + EAGLE/EAGLE3/DFLASH on a mamba-hybrid target needs the draft's KV fused into the target's pages, but this draft cannot fuse (--enable-hierarchical-cache builds the draft's host pool off a device pool of its own). A private draft pool would overcommit the KV budget the unified buffer already takes.
